key_features: Put Out Grease Fires in Seconds: Engineered with two layers of high-strength woven fiberglass and an inner fire-retardant polymer film that effectively cuts off oxygen to put out flames within seconds

Carefully Selected Materials: The edge stitching and handle straps of the fire blanket are made of fire-resistant fiberglass, unlike ordinary synthetic fiber threads, it is normal for there to be some loose fiberglass threads at the edges; this is to prevent them from coming undone and will not fall off due to high temperatures

High Temperature Resistance: Durable design withstands temperatures up to 1022°F (approximately 550°C), providing reliable protection against grease fires, electrical equipment fires, welding sparks, and more
Generous Size: 40" x 40" blanket offers ample coverage for emergency fire suppression in kitchens, workshops, factories, labs, and home environments while remaining lightweight at 3.53 pounds
Convenient Storage: Equipped with an Oxford storage bag and metal hooks, easy to place in high-risk areas and ensures quick access in emergencies
